hooks.command: OVER=$(find src public -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.js' 2>/dev/null | while read f; do lines=$(wc -l < "$f" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); if [ "$lines" -gt 500 ]; then echo "  $f ($lines lines)"; fi; done) && if [ -n "$OVER" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ FILES OVER 500 LINES — refactor before next commit:\n%s"}' "$OVER"; fi
